categories.title: Two Powerful Earthquakes Strike Venezuela, Killing at Least 164

versions.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉發生兩次大地震，到目前為止至少 164 人死亡、將近 1000 人受傷。

vocab.example: The earthquake killed many people.
Nearly 1,000 people were injured.
We will see the damage done by the earthquake.
Other countries are sending help to Venezuela.

shadowSegments.text: Two big earthquakes hit Venezuela.
shadowSegments.zh: 委內瑞拉發生了兩場大地震。

shadowSegments.text: They happened very close together.
shadowSegments.zh: 兩場地震發生的時間很接近。

shadowSegments.text: Many homes and buildings were damaged.
shadowSegments.zh: 很多房子和建築物都受損了。

shadowSegments.text: At first, the news said 32 people died.
shadowSegments.zh: 一開始，新聞說有 32 人死亡。

shadowSegments.text: But the real number was much higher.
shadowSegments.zh: 但真正的數字高出很多。

shadowSegments.text: At least 164 people died, and nearly 1,000 were hurt.
shadowSegments.zh: 至少有 164 人死亡，將近 1,000 人受傷。

shadowSegments.text: The phones and internet stopped working in many places.
shadowSegments.zh: 很多地方的電話和網路都斷了。

shadowSegments.text: So it was hard to know what really happened.
shadowSegments.zh: 所以很難知道實際發生了什麼事。

shadowSegments.text: Other countries said they want to help.
shadowSegments.zh: 其他國家表示願意幫忙。

shadowSegments.text: Spain is ready to send 54 rescue workers.
shadowSegments.zh: 西班牙準備派出 54 名救難人員。

versions.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉北部接連發生規模 7.2 和 7.5 的兩起強震，死亡人數已從最初的 32 人上修至至少 164 人。多國正派出搜救隊與軍機提供援助。

vocab.example: Rescue teams arrived in the aftermath of the earthquakes.
Officials revised the death toll up to 164.
The number of casualties kept rising as daylight broke.
Internet connectivity dropped right after the quakes.
Spain is ready to send 54 army rescuers to Venezuela.

quiz.q: "In the aftermath of" the earthquakes means ___.
If officials "revise" the figure up, they ___ it.

shadowSegments.text: Northern Venezuela was hit by not one but two powerful earthquakes.
shadowSegments.zh: 委內瑞拉北部不只發生一場，而是兩場強烈地震。

shadowSegments.text: The two quakes struck very close together in time.
shadowSegments.zh: 這兩場地震發生的時間非常接近。

shadowSegments.text: The first reports said 32 people had been killed and more than 700 injured.
shadowSegments.zh: 最初的消息說有 32 人罹難、超過 700 人受傷。

shadowSegments.text: But officials expected that number to rise quickly.
shadowSegments.zh: 但官方預期這個數字會迅速上升。

shadowSegments.text: The interim president, Delcy Rodriguez, later said at least 164 people had died.
shadowSegments.zh: 代理總統羅德里格斯後來表示，至少有 164 人死亡。

shadowSegments.text: Nearly 1,000 people were now reported injured.
shadowSegments.zh: 通報的受傷人數此時已接近 1,000 人。

shadowSegments.text: As daylight returned, people began to see the full damage.
shadowSegments.zh: 隨著天亮，人們開始看清災情的全貌。

shadowSegments.text: Internet connection had dropped sharply right after the quakes.
shadowSegments.zh: 地震過後，網路連線立刻大幅中斷。

shadowSegments.text: As more people came back online, more images of the destruction appeared.
shadowSegments.zh: 隨著更多人重新連上網路，更多災區影像陸續傳出。

shadowSegments.text: Countries around the world offered help, including planes and aid groups.
shadowSegments.zh: 世界各國紛紛表示願意協助，包括出動飛機和援助組織。

shadowSegments.text: Spain said it was ready to send 54 army rescuers to Venezuela.
shadowSegments.zh: 西班牙表示已準備好派 54 名軍方救難人員前往委內瑞拉。

versions.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉北部因坐落於加勒比板塊與南美洲板塊交界，發生罕見的「雙震序列」，連續兩起規模 7.2 與 7.5 的強震釋放出長期累積的應力。此區地質複雜、本就地震頻仍，這兩起規模在量表上屬數量級之差，皆相當嚴重。

vocab.example: Earthquakes occur when tectonic plates move past each other.

vocab.zh: 雙震序列（兩起性質相近、緊接發生的地震）
vocab.example: A doublet sequence means two similar earthquakes very close together.
Each number on the scale is an order of magnitude bigger.
This region is prone to earthquakes.
Friction and stress build up until they are released.

quiz.q: If a region is "prone to" earthquakes, it ___.
An "order of magnitude" bigger means the difference is ___.
options: 大上好幾倍（一個數量級）

shadowSegments.text: Venezuela is reeling from the aftermath of not one but two earthquakes that struck the region around Caracas.
shadowSegments.zh: 委內瑞拉正承受兩場地震過後的衝擊，這兩場地震襲擊了卡拉卡斯一帶。

shadowSegments.text: The original figure from authorities was 32 people killed and more than 700 injured.
shadowSegments.zh: 當局最初公布的數字是 32 人死亡、超過 700 人受傷。

shadowSegments.text: But even then, the expectation was that it would be revised up significantly and quickly.
shadowSegments.zh: 但即便如此，外界當時就預期數字會迅速大幅向上修正。

shadowSegments.text: Interim president Delcy Rodriguez now says at least 164 people have been killed.
shadowSegments.zh: 代理總統羅德里格斯如今表示，至少有 164 人罹難。

shadowSegments.text: Nearly 1,000 people have been injured, and that toll could still climb.
shadowSegments.zh: 受傷人數已近 1,000 人，而且傷亡數字恐怕還會攀升。

shadowSegments.text: As daylight breaks across the region, the true extent of the damage is only starting to emerge.
shadowSegments.zh: 隨著該地區天色漸亮，災情的真正規模才剛開始浮現。

shadowSegments.text: Internet connectivity dropped off sharply in the immediate aftermath of the back-to-back quakes.
shadowSegments.zh: 在這兩場接連發生的地震過後，網路連線立刻大幅中斷。

shadowSegments.text: As connectivity improves, more images of the destruction are expected to come through.
shadowSegments.zh: 隨著連線恢復，預料會有更多災區的影像陸續傳出。

shadowSegments.text: Scientists say northern Venezuela sits close to the boundary of the Caribbean and South American plates.
shadowSegments.zh: 科學家表示，委內瑞拉北部位於加勒比板塊與南美洲板塊交界附近。

shadowSegments.text: As the plates grind past each other, stress builds up and is suddenly released.
shadowSegments.zh: 當這些板塊相互摩擦推擠時，應力逐漸累積，接著突然釋放。

shadowSegments.text: This was a doublet sequence: two very big quakes, a 7.2 and a 7.5, close together.
shadowSegments.zh: 這是一次「雙震序列」：兩場非常大的地震，規模 7.2 和 7.5，緊接著發生。

shadowSegments.text: Internationally, Spain says it is ready to send 54 army rescuers, with other countries offering planes and aid.
shadowSegments.zh: 在國際上，西班牙表示已準備好派 54 名軍方救難人員，其他國家也提供飛機與援助。

shadow_segments.text: Yes, so earthquakes occur when effectively tectonic plates, so that's the upper outer layer of the earth, is split into lots of these different plates, and they're all moving past each other very gradually.
shadow_segments.zh: 是的，地震基本上發生在板塊運動的時候，板塊就是地球最外層的部分，它被分裂成許多不同的板塊，而它們全都非常緩慢地彼此錯動。

shadow_segments.text: In this case, northern Venezuela sits very close to the boundary of two plates, the Caribbean plate and the South American plate.
shadow_segments.zh: 在這個案例中，委內瑞拉北部非常靠近兩個板塊的交界，也就是加勒比板塊和南美洲板塊。

shadow_segments.text: They are moving past each other, and what can happen is they can get stuck.
shadow_segments.zh: 它們彼此錯動，而可能發生的狀況是它們會卡住。

shadow_segments.text: Friction and stress builds up, and that gets released.
shadow_segments.zh: 摩擦力和壓力不斷累積，然後一口氣釋放出來。

shadow_segments.text: That's what's happened here.
shadow_segments.zh: 這就是這次發生的事。

shadow_segments.text: In fact, this is a very complex part of the world in terms of its geology, and we had something called a doublet sequence.
shadow_segments.zh: 事實上，就地質而言這是世界上非常複雜的地區之一，這次出現了所謂的「雙震序列」。

shadow_segments.text: Effectively, what that means is two earthquakes similar in nature very close together.
shadow_segments.zh: 簡單來說，那指的是兩個性質相近、發生時間非常接近的地震。

shadow_segments.text: In this case, two very big earthquakes, a 7.2 and a 7.5.
shadow_segments.zh: 在這次的情況裡，是兩個非常大的地震，分別是規模 7.2 和 7.5。

shadow_segments.text: In terms of how big they are, earthquakes can go up to size nine, that's highly unusual.
shadow_segments.zh: 就規模大小而言，地震最大可達規模九，那是極為罕見的。

shadow_segments.text: The way that that scale works is they are orders of magnitude bigger with each number.
shadow_segments.zh: 這個量表的運作方式是，每增加一個數字，規模就大上好幾個數量級。

shadow_segments.text: So, you can imagine that a 7.5 is significantly bigger than a 7.2.
shadow_segments.zh: 所以你可以想像，規模 7.5 比 7.2 大上許多。

shadow_segments.text: So, this region is prone to earthquakes, not unexpected, but both significant.
shadow_segments.zh: 因此這個地區本來就容易發生地震，並不令人意外，但這兩起都相當嚴重。

categories.summary_zh: 委內瑞拉北部接連發生規模 7.2 和 7.5 的兩起強震，死亡人數已從最初的 32 人上修至至少 164 人。多國正派出搜救隊與軍機提供援助。

categories.title: Kerry Says Iran War Never Should Have Happened

versions.summary_zh: 美國前國務卿凱瑞說，這場對伊朗的戰爭本來就不該打。他說現在的停火不是和平協議，只是暫時停下來而已。

vocab.example: He said this war never had to happen.
People want peace, not more fighting.
It does not stop the nuclear program.
This is not a real peace agreement.

shadowSegments.text: John Kerry says this war never should have happened.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞說這場戰爭根本不該發生。

shadowSegments.text: He calls it a war of choice.
shadowSegments.zh: 他說這是一場可以選擇避免的戰爭。

shadowSegments.text: The president's reasons for the war keep changing.
shadowSegments.zh: 總統開戰的理由一直在變。

shadowSegments.text: Kerry also says this is not a real peace deal.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞還說，這並不是真正的和平協議。

shadowSegments.text: It is only a short pause for now.
shadowSegments.zh: 目前只是暫時停下來而已。

shadowSegments.text: The Strait of Hormuz is still a big problem.
shadowSegments.zh: 荷莫茲海峽仍然是個大問題。

shadowSegments.text: It has hurt the world's economy a lot.
shadowSegments.zh: 它已經嚴重傷害了全世界的經濟。

shadowSegments.text: Kerry warns that the bombs cannot stop Iran's nuclear knowledge.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞警告，炸彈無法消除伊朗的核子技術知識。

shadowSegments.text: The old deal had inspectors to watch Iran.
shadowSegments.zh: 舊的協議有檢查人員在監督伊朗。

shadowSegments.text: Now that control is gone.
shadowSegments.zh: 現在那樣的管控已經沒有了。

versions.summary_zh: 凱瑞批評這是一場「選擇打的戰爭」，總統的開戰理由一改再改。他強調現在的狀態只是暫時停火，不是和平協議，而且光是讓荷莫茲海峽重開，也無法阻止伊朗的核計畫。

vocab.example: The president's rationale for the war kept changing.
It's only a temporary halt, not a lasting peace.
The fighting is on a temporary halt for now.
Opening the Straits does not prevent a nuclear weapon.
Reopening trade is an urgent necessity for everybody.

quiz.q: What is the closest meaning of "temporary"?

shadowSegments.text: Former Secretary of State John Kerry says this war never should have happened.
shadowSegments.zh: 前國務卿凱瑞表示，這場戰爭根本不該發生。

shadowSegments.text: He calls it a war of choice, not a war of necessity.
shadowSegments.zh: 他稱這是一場可以選擇避免的戰爭，而不是非打不可的戰爭。

shadowSegments.text: According to Kerry, the president's reasons for fighting have changed many times.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞指出，總統開戰的理由已經改變了好多次。

shadowSegments.text: He also pushes back on calling the result a peace agreement.
shadowSegments.zh: 他也反對把這個結果稱為和平協議。

shadowSegments.text: In his view, it is only a temporary halt in the conflict.
shadowSegments.zh: 在他看來，這只是衝突中暫時的停火。

shadowSegments.text: The fighting has badly disrupted the world's economy through the Strait of Hormuz.
shadowSegments.zh: 這場衝突透過荷莫茲海峽，重創了全球經濟。

shadowSegments.text: Reopening the strait is urgent for everyone, Kerry says.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞說，重新打開海峽對所有人來說都很急迫。

shadowSegments.text: But he warns that bombing does not stop Iran's nuclear program.
shadowSegments.zh: 但他警告，轟炸並不能阻止伊朗的核子計畫。

shadowSegments.text: You cannot bomb the knowledge away from the scientists, he explains.
shadowSegments.zh: 他解釋說，你無法用炸彈把科學家腦中的知識炸掉。

shadowSegments.text: The earlier deal had inspectors and a clear process to check Iran.
shadowSegments.zh: 之前的協議有檢查人員和明確的查核程序來監督伊朗。

shadowSegments.text: Today, Kerry says, none of those checks are in place.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞說，如今那些查核機制都不存在了。

versions.summary_zh: 凱瑞主張這是一場「選擇性戰爭」，總統所謂的開戰理由前後矛盾、不斷變調，外界誤把暫時停火當成和平協議。他指出荷莫茲海峽的動盪嚴重扭曲全球經濟，但軍事打擊既無法消除科學家腦中的知識，也比不上當年那份能隨時查核的核協議來得有效。

vocab.zh: 選擇性戰爭（並非被迫、而是主動發動的戰爭）
vocab.example: Critics called it a war of choice that never had to happen.
The crisis in the Straits has distorted the economies of the world.
By virtue of what happened in the Straits, trade collapsed.
The prior deal had checks and balances and on-demand inspections.
The strikes discombobulated the supply of enriched uranium.

quiz.q: A "war of choice" is best described as a war that ___.
If something is "distorted," it has been ___.

shadowSegments.text: Former Secretary of State John Kerry argues this is a war that never should have happened and never had to happen.
shadowSegments.zh: 前國務卿凱瑞主張，這是一場根本不該、也不必發生的戰爭。

shadowSegments.text: He calls it a war of choice in which the president's stated rationale has changed many times.
shadowSegments.zh: 他稱這是一場可選擇的戰爭，總統公開的開戰理由還變了好幾次。

shadowSegments.text: Kerry insists people need to stop calling this a peace agreement.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞堅持，大家不該再把這稱作和平協議。

shadowSegments.text: In his words, it is only a temporary halt while the sides try to find agreement on nuclear issues.
shadowSegments.zh: 用他的話說，這只是雙方試圖就核子問題達成共識前的暫時停火。

shadowSegments.text: He notes that the Strait of Hormuz has completely distorted the economies of the world.
shadowSegments.zh: 他指出，荷莫茲海峽的情勢已徹底扭曲了全球各國的經濟。

shadowSegments.text: Reopening it is an urgent necessity for everybody, he acknowledges.
shadowSegments.zh: 他也承認，重新打開海峽對所有人來說都是當務之急。

shadowSegments.text: Yet getting that done does not prevent a nuclear weapon or stop the program.
shadowSegments.zh: 然而做到這件事，並無法阻止核武或停下整個核子計畫。

shadowSegments.text: As he puts it, you can't bomb the knowledge away from the scientists who work on it in Iran.
shadowSegments.zh: 正如他所說，你無法把伊朗從事相關研究的科學家腦中的知識炸掉。

shadowSegments.text: Kerry says the prior deal was the strongest nuclear agreement in history.
shadowSegments.zh: 凱瑞說，先前那份協議是史上最強的核子協議。

shadowSegments.text: It had checks and balances and the ability to inspect Iran on demand.
shadowSegments.zh: 它有制衡機制，也能隨時要求進入伊朗進行檢查。

shadowSegments.text: He argues Trump had ample opportunity to renegotiate that deal through the United Nations.
shadowSegments.zh: 他主張，川普原本有充裕的機會透過聯合國重新談判那份協議。

shadowSegments.text: Instead of putting alternatives in front of the Iranians, he says, they just started bombing.
shadowSegments.zh: 但他說，美方沒有向伊朗提出任何替代方案，而是直接開始轟炸。

shadow_segments.text: This is a war that never should have happened, never had to happen.
shadow_segments.zh: 這是一場本來不該發生、也不需要發生的戰爭。

shadow_segments.text: It's a war of choice in which the president's stated rationale for engaging in this war has changed many times.
shadow_segments.zh: 這是一場主動選擇的戰爭，而總統開戰所宣稱的理由已經改了很多次。

shadow_segments.text: And you also regrettably have not a peace agreement.
shadow_segments.zh: 而且很遺憾，你們手上根本沒有和平協議。

shadow_segments.text: I mean people need to stop calling this a peace agreement.
shadow_segments.zh: 我的意思是，大家別再把這個叫做和平協議了。

shadow_segments.text: It's not a peace agreement.
shadow_segments.zh: 這不是和平協議。

shadow_segments.text: It's a temporary halt while they try to find whether they can get agreement on nuclear and in the meantime open up the Straits.
shadow_segments.zh: 這只是暫時停火，趁這段期間看看能不能就核問題達成協議，同時讓海峽重新開放。

shadow_segments.text: Now, you know, we all want that to happen.
shadow_segments.zh: 你知道，我們都希望那件事能成。

shadow_segments.text: Obviously the world has been completely distorted the economies of the world by virtue of what's happened with the Straits of Hormuz.
shadow_segments.zh: 顯然因為荷莫茲海峽發生的事，全世界的經濟都被徹底扭曲了。

shadow_segments.text: So that's an urgent necessity for the everybody.
shadow_segments.zh: 所以那對所有人來說都是當務之急。

shadow_segments.text: But getting that done does not prevent a nuclear weapon.
shadow_segments.zh: 但就算把那件事做成，也擋不住核武。

shadow_segments.text: It doesn't stop the nuclear program.
shadow_segments.zh: 它阻止不了核計畫。

shadow_segments.text: I mean you can't bomb the knowledge away from the scientists who work on it in Iran.
shadow_segments.zh: 我的意思是，你沒辦法靠轟炸把伊朗那些科學家腦中的知識炸掉。

categories.summary_zh: 凱瑞批評這是一場「選擇打的戰爭」，總統的開戰理由一改再改。他強調現在的狀態只是暫時停火，不是和平協議，而且光是讓荷莫茲海峽重開，也無法阻止伊朗的核計畫。

vocab.example: The president's rationale for the war kept changing.
It's only a temporary halt, not a lasting peace.
The fighting is on a temporary halt for now.
Opening the Straits does not prevent a nuclear weapon.
Reopening trade is an urgent necessity for everybody.

quiz.q: What is the closest meaning of "temporary"?

categories.title: LaMelo Ball Could Be Traded as Teams Pursue Hornets Star

versions.summary_zh: NBA 球星 LaMelo Ball 可能被交易。很多球隊都想要他，未來一兩天內可能會有消息。

vocab.example: Many teams want this player.
He is a very popular player.
The team may trade him soon.
He has three years left on his contract.

quiz.q: If a team wants to "trade" a player, they want to ___.

shadowSegments.text: It is NBA draft week, and people are talking about trades.
shadowSegments.zh: 現在是 NBA 選秀週，大家都在聊交易。

shadowSegments.text: One big name is LaMelo Ball.
shadowSegments.zh: 其中一個大名字就是 LaMelo Ball。

shadowSegments.text: He plays for the Charlotte Hornets.
shadowSegments.zh: 他效力於夏洛特黃蜂隊。

shadowSegments.text: Many teams want him right now.
shadowSegments.zh: 現在很多球隊都想要他。

shadowSegments.text: The Hornets are talking to other teams.
shadowSegments.zh: 黃蜂隊正在跟其他球隊談。

shadowSegments.text: Ball had a strong end to the season.
shadowSegments.zh: Ball 賽季尾聲打得很好。

shadowSegments.text: He wants to stay in Charlotte.
shadowSegments.zh: 他想留在夏洛特。

shadowSegments.text: But some teams are making big offers.
shadowSegments.zh: 但有些球隊開出很大的條件。

shadowSegments.text: If the price is right, he could be traded.
shadowSegments.zh: 如果條件夠好，他可能就會被交易。

shadowSegments.text: We may know more in one or two days.

shadowSegments.text: It is draft week in the NBA, but everyone is already turning the page to free agency.
shadowSegments.zh: 現在是 NBA 選秀週，但大家其實已經把焦點轉到自由市場了。

shadowSegments.text: One star whose name is picking up steam in the trade market is Charlotte's LaMelo Ball.
shadowSegments.zh: 在交易市場上聲量越來越大的一位球星，就是夏洛特的 LaMelo Ball。

shadowSegments.text: Multiple teams are strongly pursuing him right now.
shadowSegments.zh: 現在有好幾支球隊都在積極追求他。

shadowSegments.text: The Hornets are engaged in talks, and Ball had a strong finish to the season.
shadowSegments.zh: 黃蜂隊也參與了討論，而 Ball 賽季尾段表現很強勢。

shadowSegments.text: Both sides have been in a good place, and Ball does want to stay in Charlotte.
shadowSegments.zh: 雙方關係一直不錯，Ball 自己也想留在夏洛特。

shadowSegments.text: Still, the team is fielding some aggressive offers from other clubs.
shadowSegments.zh: 不過球隊正收到其他隊伍開出的進攻性報價。

shadowSegments.text: He has played his entire career with the Hornets and still has three years left on his deal.
shadowSegments.zh: 他整個職業生涯都在黃蜂隊，合約還剩三年。

shadowSegments.text: Charlotte must decide if he is part of their future or a chance to cash in on a strong year.
shadowSegments.zh: 夏洛特得決定他是球隊的未來，還是趁這個好賽季把他換成籌碼。

shadowSegments.text: The Hornets seem ready to pivot toward younger players like Brandon Miller.
shadowSegments.zh: 黃蜂似乎準備轉向 Brandon Miller 這類更年輕的球員。

shadowSegments.text: If the price is met, Ball could very well be on the move.
shadowSegments.zh: 只要條件談妥，Ball 很有可能就會被交易走。

shadowSegments.text: This is a developing story that could break over the next 24 to 48 hours.
shadowSegments.zh: 這是個還在發展中的消息，可能在接下來 24 到 48 小時內就有結果。

versions.summary_zh: 在選秀週、逐步逼近自由球員市場之際，黃蜂正權衡是否該趁 LaMelo Ball 打出強勢一年時把握機會（capitalize）將他交易。多隊端出積極報價，球團也藉此重整陣容、轉向以新核心為主，整起交易仍在發酵，未來一兩天內可能定案。

categories.title: Pompeii: Out of Time, a Story of Survival

versions.summary_zh: 大家都以為龐貝城只是個關於死亡的故事，但其實也有人活了下來。這部片要去找出那些倖存者，把他們的故事說出來。

vocab.example: Pompeii has a sad story.
The story is about death.
It is a story of survival.
There are clues if you look.

shadowSegments.text: We all know the story of Pompeii.
shadowSegments.zh: 我們都聽過龐貝城的故事。

shadowSegments.text: Most people think it is a story of death.
shadowSegments.zh: 大部分的人都覺得這是個關於死亡的故事。

shadowSegments.text: But there is another story to tell.
shadowSegments.zh: 但其實還有另一個故事可以講。

shadowSegments.text: It is a story of survival.
shadowSegments.zh: 這是一個關於倖存的故事。

shadowSegments.text: The city took a full day to be covered in ash.
shadowSegments.zh: 整座城市花了一整天才被火山灰蓋住。

shadowSegments.text: In that one day, some people had a chance to run.
shadowSegments.zh: 在那一天裡，有些人有機會可以逃。

shadowSegments.text: Today we look for clues about these real people.
shadowSegments.zh: 今天我們要尋找這些真實人物留下的線索。

shadowSegments.text: Each survivor left a story behind.
shadowSegments.zh: 每一個倖存者都留下了一個故事。

shadowSegments.text: In Pompeii, the past feels very close.
shadowSegments.zh: 在龐貝城，過去感覺離我們好近。

versions.summary_zh: 我們熟悉的龐貝城故事總是和死亡連在一起，但這部片想換個角度，講倖存者的故事。透過遺留的線索追尋真實的人，彷彿能在過去與現在之間穿梭時空。

vocab.example: Scientists trace real people through the disaster.
The eruption was a terrible disaster.
The team gathers evidence from the ruins.
The film follows two timelines, past and present.
The discovery is very impressive.

shadowSegments.text: We all know the story of Pompeii, and most of us think it is a story of death.
shadowSegments.zh: 我們都聽過龐貝城的故事，而大多數人都以為這是個關於死亡的故事。

shadowSegments.text: But what if there is another story to tell here?
shadowSegments.zh: 但如果這裡其實還藏著另一個故事呢？

shadowSegments.text: This is a story of survival, not just of disaster.
shadowSegments.zh: 這是個關於倖存的故事，而不只是災難。

shadowSegments.text: Surprisingly, it took a whole day for the city to be buried in ash.
shadowSegments.zh: 出乎意料的是，整座城被火山灰掩埋花了一整天。

shadowSegments.text: A day is a long time, and a long time means a chance.
shadowSegments.zh: 一天其實很長，而很長的時間就代表著機會。

shadowSegments.text: The goal is to trace real people through the disaster and find the survivors.
shadowSegments.zh: 目標就是循著真實人物的蹤跡，在這場災難中找出倖存者。

shadowSegments.text: There are clues everywhere if you know where to look.
shadowSegments.zh: 只要你知道往哪裡找，到處都有線索。

shadowSegments.text: Here, evidence and imagination mix together to bring that day back to life.
shadowSegments.zh: 在這裡，證據和想像交織在一起，把那一天重新喚醒。

shadowSegments.text: Every survivor left behind a story of what that day was really like.
shadowSegments.zh: 每個倖存者都留下了一個故事，訴說那一天究竟是什麼樣子。

shadowSegments.text: In Pompeii, you can almost time travel, because the past feels so close.
shadowSegments.zh: 在龐貝城，你幾乎可以穿越時空，因為過去感覺如此貼近。

versions.summary_zh: 龐貝城向來被講成一則死亡敘事，但這部紀錄片翻轉視角，主打倖存者的故事。它結合考古證據與想像力，在過去與現在兩條時間線間穿梭，凸顯這座城其實花了整整一天才被火山灰封存，留下無數可供追索的人生片段。

shadowSegments.text: We all know the story of Pompeii, and we think we know how it ends.

shadowSegments.text: For centuries it has been told as a story of death, but what if there is another story to tell?

shadowSegments.text: This is a story of survival, and it begins with one surprising fact.

shadowSegments.text: Pompeii actually took a full day to be entombed in ash, and that day was a chance to escape.

shadowSegments.text: The goal is to trace real people through the disaster and find the survivors among them.
shadowSegments.zh: 目標就是循著真實人物的足跡走過這場災難，並從中找出倖存者。

shadowSegments.text: There are clues everywhere, if you know where to look.
shadowSegments.zh: 只要你知道往哪裡看，線索其實到處都是。

shadowSegments.text: Here, evidence and imagination intermingle, until you can almost step into two timelines at once, past and present.
shadowSegments.zh: 在這裡，證據與想像彼此交織，直到你幾乎能同時踏進兩條時間線：過去與現在。

shadowSegments.text: Every one of these people left behind a story of what it was like to live through that day.
shadowSegments.zh: 這些人每一個都留下了一個故事，訴說親身經歷那一天是什麼感受。

shadowSegments.text: Buried in the ruins, there is something here you are really going to want to see.
shadowSegments.zh: 在這片廢墟之中，藏著一些你絕對會想親眼看看的東西。

shadowSegments.text: This is the story we do not yet know, and it is the one worth telling.
shadowSegments.zh: 這是我們還不知道的故事，也是最值得被講述的那一個。

shadowSegments.text: In Pompeii, the past feels so close that there is no time to waste.
shadowSegments.zh: 在龐貝城，過去近得彷彿觸手可及，讓人一刻都不想浪費。
